finding.problem: Removing the closed-lower tiebreak from sort() makes merge() order-dependent, so touching intervals with equal lower bounds are left unmerged in normalize/union/difference (e.g. [0,1) + (1,5] + [1,3] yields two intervals instead of [0,5]).
